title: 3819. Rotate Non Negative Elements

examples.explanation: The non-negative elements, in order, are [1, 3]. Left rotation with k = 3 results in: [1, 3] -> [3, 1] -> [1, 3] -> [3, 1] Placing them back into the non-negative indices results in [3, -2, 1, -4].
The non-negative elements, in order, are [7]. Left rotation with k = 1 results in [7]. Placing them back into the non-negative indices results in [-3, -2, 7].
The non-negative elements, in order, are [5, 4, 6]. Left rotation with k = 2 results in [6, 5, 4]. Placing them back into the non-negative indices results in [6, 5, -9, 4].
